description: This file defines an interface for building responses to 'RetrieveAttributes' commands within a live signals command framework. It provides methods to create responses containing attribute data or error responses indicating access issues.

classes.name: RetrieveAttributesLiveCommandAnswerBuilder
classes.description: An interface for building answer responses to 'RetrieveAttributes' commands, extending query command response capabilities.

classes.name: RetrieveAttributesLiveCommandAnswerBuilder.ResponseFactory
classes.description: Nested interface for creating specific responses to RetrieveAttributes commands, either with attribute data or access error.

methods.name: retrieved
methods.description: Creates a response containing the retrieved attributes for the command.

methods.name: attributesNotAccessibleError
methods.description: Creates an error response indicating that attributes are not accessible or permissions are insufficient.
